verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly publish a public API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing blanket 'Disallow: /' rules, plus a named GPTBot ban on the separate state-tax host, and nothing documents any public API for the Commission's systems. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields 'none'.
